# PolicySources

> **Kind:** context · **Registry:** host · **Folder:** [`src/onnx/`](../folders/src-onnx.md)
> **Source:** [`src/onnx/policy_systems.h`](../../../src/onnx/policy_systems.h)

## Summary

What each world's policy is, for panels and overlays.

## Description

Emplaced by the ModelWatcherSys constructor; filled on its first tick (one PolicySource per world, in world index order) and updated on every load or load failure. Read by SphereView's panel. PolicySource fields: spec (the model parameter string), file (loaded checkpoint path, empty before the first load), step (from <behavior>-<step>.onnx, -1 when the name has none), error (last load error, cleared on success).

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `worlds` | `std::vector<PolicySource>` | empty | Indexed by world index; find(world) returns nullptr out of range. |
